chain.title: Bought, Not Found
chain.desc: The Evil Eye is the one eye you can trade for: a Cleric villager sells it for emeralds and an ender eye.

chain.title: Sand Over the Sandworm
chain.desc: The Old Eye hides in desert pyramid chests and, far more rarely, in plain dungeon chests.

chain.title: Forged Before Memory
chain.desc: The Lost Eye turns up in abandoned mineshaft chests and occasionally in dungeon chests.

chain.title: Left by the Iceologers
chain.desc: The Cold Eye is the most generous of the sixteen, appearing in most igloo basement chests.

chain.title: Welcome to the Jungle
chain.desc: The Rogue Eye waits behind the tripwires and dispensers of a jungle temple.

chain.title: Arr, Where Be Me Ship
chain.desc: The Black Eye comes from buried treasure, and much more rarely from shipwreck treasure chests.

chain.title: A Greedy King's Fortune
chain.desc: The Corrupted Eye sits in pillager outpost chests, high above the raiders.

chain.title: No Power Without It
chain.desc: The Magical Eye drops from Evokers and is also stashed in woodland mansion chests.

chain.title: Riderless in the Storm
chain.desc: The Undead Soul drops from Skeleton Horses, the ones that spawn out of lightning traps.

chain.title: The Mirror of the Soul
chain.desc: Bone, rotten flesh, phantom membrane and a ghast tear ring an Undead Soul to make the Undead Eye.

chain.title: Plucked From the Brewer
chain.desc: The Witch Pupil drops from Witches and is the raw form of the Witch Eye.

chain.title: Recipes Lost in Time
chain.desc: A Witch Pupil and a vanilla ender eye combine, shapeless, into the Witch Eye.

chain.title: Lost in a War of Realms
chain.desc: The Nether Eye is a nether fortress chest drop, deep in the corridors above the lava.

chain.title: The Piglins Swore to Protect It
chain.desc: The Cursed Eye is in bastion treasure chests, at the best odds of any structure eye in the mod.

chain.title: Watching Warriors Drown
chain.desc: The Guardian Eye drops from Elder Guardians at the heart of an ocean monument.

chain.title: Where's Atlantis
chain.desc: The only fully crafted eye: two conduits, four corals, two glow ink sacs and a vanilla ender eye.

chain.title: It Has Witnessed Destruction
chain.desc: The Wither Eye is the surest drop in End Remastered, rolled twice off a slain Wither.

chain.title: Patience Is the Road to Wisdom
chain.desc: The Cryptic Eye has no recipe and no chest: it appears in your inventory, at random, while enchanting.

chain.title: Sixteen Sockets, One Door
chain.desc: End Remastered swaps the vanilla end portal for frames that accept only its own eyes.

notes: Verified against endrem_forge-5.3.3-R-1.20.1 (Modrinth slug 'endrem', NOT 'end-remastered' - that 404s). CORRECTION to the brief: this version has SIXTEEN eyes, not twelve - black, cold, corrupted, cryptic, cursed, evil, exotic, guardian, lost, magical, nether, old, rogue, undead, witch, wither - plus two catalysts (undead_soul, witch_pupil) and the ancient_portal_frame block. moddb lists all sixteen too. Every source was read out of the jar rather than guessed: eleven chest loot tables under data/endrem/loot_tables/minecraft/chests, five entity loot tables under .../entities, three recipes (exotic_eye, undead_eye, witch_eye), and two behaviours only present as bytecode - CrypticEyeDistribution.rollForCrypticEye adds the Cryptic Eye straight to the player inventory while enchanting (config is_cryptic_eye_obtainable) and ModEvents$EREyeTrade appends an Evil Eye listing to VillagerProfession CLERIC (config is_evil_eye_obtainable). Sixteen eyes exceeds the 14-member wheel cap, so they are split into a structure-and-trade wheel and a mob-and-craft wheel, hubbed on the two non-eye items so no member is duplicated. Chain order broadly follows moddb consensus with one deliberate conflict: moddb ranks exotic_eye second (pos 0.346) but its recipe consumes two Conduits, so it is placed near the end here; the two catalysts are likewise pulled ahead of the eyes they craft. The mod registers no entities of its own, so there are no kill: steps - every eye-dropping mob (Wither, Elder Guardian, Evoker, Witch, Skeleton Horse) is vanilla and is named in the descriptions instead. Item model 'lost_frame' has no lang key and was dropped.
